sections.title: Loading Notes:
lines: • Percentages are off the 1RM Deadlift; overall effort stays below RPE 7 today.
• The goal is quality touches on the deadlift, not a heavy day, so do not build past the written percentages.
• Reset the brace between reps, touch and go only if the setup stays identical rep to rep.
• Setup: Shoulders over the bar, lats engaged, midline braced before the pull.
• Pull: Push the floor away, bar tracks close to the legs, hips and shoulders rise together.
• Finish: Stand to full extension with the glutes, control the bar back to the floor.

5 Barbell Good Mornings
lines: Then load to 75% of the 1RM Front Squat before the clock starts.

sections.title: Loading Notes:
lines: • Load is the same across all ten minutes: 5 sets of 3 Front Squats and 5 sets of 5 Back Squats, all at 75% of the 1RM Front Squat.
• Percentage is taken from the FRONT squat max only, do not calculate the back squat sets off a back squat number.
• Reps come from the rack and are meant to be done with quality speed and position; if elbows drop or depth changes, end the set instead of grinding.
• Front Squat: Elbows high, big brace before the un-rack, torso tall through the bottom.
• Back Squat: Bar settled, mid-foot pressure, root through the floor, hips below parallel every rep.
• Both: Hips and shoulders rise together, stand to full extension before resetting.

sections.title: Modifications:
lines: • Level 1: Moderate load by feel for quality reps, or Dual Dumbbell Front Squats and Dual Dumbbell Back Squats.
• Hotel Gym / Travel: 3 Goblet Squats + 5 Dual Dumbbell Front Rack Squats at a moderate load.

sections.title: 1 Snatch Pull + 1 Snatch High Pull + 1 Power Snatch
Loading Notes:
lines: • Start at 65% of the 1RM Power Snatch and build across the six sets to a heavy for the day.
• Build only when the bar path stays close and the power snatch is caught above parallel without a press out.
• Box Jump is one max effort rep after the barbell, athlete choice on height, step down and reset.
• Snatch Pull: Shoulders over the bar off the floor, lats on, patient until the hips finish.
• Snatch High Pull: Elbows high and outside, bar stays against the body, no early arm bend.
• Power Snatch: Punch under fast, receive above parallel, lock out and stand it up.

sections.title: FIGHT GONE BAD
lines: How do you perform the “Fight Gone Bad” workout?

Perform 1 minute of work at each of the 5 stations. Move immediately to the next station after 1 minute. The clock does not reset or stop between exercises. One-minute break is allowed before repeating each round. One point is given for each rep, except on the rower where each calorie is one point.
How do you score the “Fight Gone Bad” workout?
*Score is the total cumulative number of repetitions completed of all movements in all 3 rounds.*

lines: Lean for Life, Part 1: How To Control Your Appetite and Maintain a Healthy Body Weight Forever

"Eat less and move more" has been the advice for decades, yet global obesity has more than doubled since 1990. Learn the four faces of hunger, from your body's built-in meal schedule to brain-driven cravings, and why understanding them is the first step to staying lean for life.
